title: "Technology"

```{python}
#| output: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import pandas as pd
from dash_helpers import load, count_bar, heatmap

studies = load("studies.csv")
modality = load("modality_long.csv")
```

## Row {height=50%}

```{python}
#| title: Studies by display device
count_bar(studies["device_label"])
```

```{python}
#| title: Studies by dimensionality
count_bar(studies["dimensionality_label"], color="#f16913")
```

## Row {height=50%}

```{python}
#| title: Studies by image modality
count_bar(modality["image_modalities_label"], color="#41ab5d")
```

```{python}
#| title: "Device × image modality"
#| classes: mobile-scroll
merged = modality.merge(
    studies[["record_id", "device_label"]], on="record_id"
)
cross = pd.crosstab(merged["device_label"], merged["image_modalities_label"])
heatmap(cross, xlab="Image modality", ylab="Device")
```
